description:
# Status Tracking System Consolidation

Unify the multiple overlapping status tracking systems (Linear, internal) into a single source of truth. Provide sync adapters for external systems while maintaining internal consistency.

## Rationale
Technical debt item: Multiple overlapping status tracking systems. Reduces confusion, improves reliability, and simplifies maintenance. Ensures task status is always accurate and consistent.

## User Stories
- As a developer, I want task status to be the same in Turret and Linear so that I'm not confused
- As a team member, I want status updates to sync automatically so that I don't have to update multiple systems

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Single internal status system is the source of truth
- [ ] Linear integration syncs bidirectionally with internal status
- [ ] Status changes are atomic and immediately consistent
- [ ] Conflict resolution is automatic with user notification
- [ ] Status history is retained for audit purposes
